headquarters.en: No permanent secretariat (rotating annual presidency; France holds it in 2026)
headquarters.zh: 無常設秘書處（年度輪值主席國；2026年由法國擔任）

nature.en: Informal intergovernmental forum of major advanced democracies
nature.zh: 主要先進民主國家的非正式政府間論壇

purpose.en: Leaders of seven large advanced economies meet every year to coordinate on the world economy, trade, security and global challenges such as climate and energy.
purpose.zh: 七個大型先進經濟體的領袖每年聚會，協調全球經濟、貿易、安全，以及氣候與能源等全球議題。

non_state_members.note: 'Non-enumerated' participant: attends all summits (since 1977/1981) but is not counted among the seven and does not hold the presidency.

notes: Founded 1975 as G6 (Rambouillet); Canada joined 1976. Russia was part of the G8 from 1997 and was suspended in 2014 (Crimea), effectively ending the G8; Russia is not listed.
2026 presidency: France (Evian summit, June 2026). No membership changes in 2025-2026.
